<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_references.py; edit specs/dasdae-inventory.yml instead. -->

A characterization of the optical path or its components, capturing the conditions loss and reflectance values were obtained under.

::: {.note}
One record per run or claim; every value derived from the same run references the same record. A datasheet claim is a legitimate record (method="datasheet").
:::

Aliases: `OptMeas`, `Measurement`

## Attributes

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `resource_id` | str | Stable identifier for this shareable inventory resource. |
| `name` | str | Human-readable measurement name. |
| `method` | str | How the values were obtained, such as otdr, power_meter, splicer_estimate, or datasheet. |
| `time` | datetime64 | Time of the measurement (UTC). |
| `wavelength` | float \| None | Measurement wavelength in nanometers. |
| `pulse_width` | float \| None | OTDR pulse width in seconds. |
| `direction` | str | Measurement direction, forward or reverse. |
| `data` | [ExternalResource](ExternalResource.qmd) \| None | The trace or report file, as a resource reference. |
